description: This PHP source file defines the DetailViewMetaParser class responsible for parsing HTML files of the DetailView from older SugarCRM versions and converting them into metadata definitions. It includes methods for reading and processing HTML, extracting field information, and merging metadata.

classes.name: DetailViewMetaParser
classes.description: A class that extends MetaParser to parse pre-5.0 SugarCRM DetailView HTML files and generate metadata definitions, with methods for parsing and transforming HTML content.
